# f5xc_protocol_inspection (Data Source)

Protocol Inspection Protocol Inspection view defines the required parameters that can be used in CRUD, to create and manage Protocol Inspection. It can be used to create Protocol Inspection. View will create the following child objects. * DNS Compliance Checks
